title: Crash on disconnect when peer already cleaned up link dir
description:
When one side disconnects and cleans up the link directory, the other side crashes with ENOENT if writeMeta is called (e.g. from a queued heartbeat or during disconnect cleanup).

Stack trace:
  error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '~/.pi/links/<id>/meta.json'
    at writeMeta (types.ts:98:19)

Fix: make writeMeta tolerant of missing directories — catch ENOENT and silently ignore. Already applied.

Root cause: cleanup() only the host removes the dir, but the guest may still have a heartbeat callback queued that fires after the host's cleanup. Race condition between stopHeartbeat() and the event loop.

title: Persistent links across session reload
description:
Currently /reload kills UDS connections. Links should survive by storing peer metadata in the session and reconnecting on session_start.

Changes:
- Store link info (linkId, mode, peer session) in session state
- On session_start, check for stored links and attempt reconnect
- If reconnect fails, notify user but don't crash
- /link status shows recovery state

title: Cross-machine links via A2A/ACP HTTP adapter
description:
Phase 3: extend links beyond same-machine UDS to work across servers.

Design:
- HTTP adapter layer that wraps the UDS protocol in A2A/ACP-compatible HTTP endpoints
- Authentication via shared secret or mTLS
- Discovery via DNS or well-known endpoint
- Falls back to UDS when target is localhost

Use case: linking sessions on server1 and server2 for cross-server agent coordination.

Reference: DESIGN.md has the full protocol mapping.

title: Multi-link support
description:
Currently only one link can be active at a time. Support multiple simultaneous links so an agent can delegate to several peers.

Changes needed:
- links: LinkMeta[] (currently single linkId)
- /link list to show all active links
- link_send_task needs a target parameter (link ID or label)
- Widget shows all links with status
- Each link maintains its own heartbeat/state

Use case: supervising multiple Village builder worktrees in parallel.

title: Streaming results via task/stream
description:
Currently task/send waits for full completion before returning the result. For long-running tasks this feels slow.

Implement the task/stream method already defined in types.ts:
- Agent sends task/stream request
- Peer streams intermediate results as JSON-RPC notifications
- Each chunk renders incrementally in the sender's session
- Final chunk triggers the completion

This maps to the streaming phase of A2A's Task model.

title: Detect half-open link connections
description:
When a peer session reloads or its link client drops, the other side still reports connected: true. Need heartbeat-based detection: if no ping response within N seconds, mark as disconnected and notify the user.

Symptoms:
- link_status returns connected: true on one side, connected: false on the other
- Tasks sent to a half-open link sit in the socket buffer with no reader
- No error surfaced to the sending agent

Acceptance:
- Periodic ping with timeout (e.g. 10s)
- State transitions: connected → disconnected with event/notice
- Reconnection attempt or clean teardown on detection
